violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. . Wiping clothes shall be stored in a sanitizer solution when not being used.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food * (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. . In house made side dishes not labeled with date prepared or use by date. Soup or cheese in a metal pot not labeled.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface * was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. . Laminent countertops cracked and broken exposing wood underneath.

Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not designed and/or maintained properly. . Vent hood system does not evacuate smoke and grease vapor properly. Walls and ceilings are accumulating grease.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned adequately. . Clean in place equipment (cabinet faces, door handles, fryer, broiler) require cleaning.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling * were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. . Floor tiles cracked and broken making cleaning difficult. Ceiling tiles missing. in the storage room above single service items.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors, walls, and ceiling in the kitchen caked with grease.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment * that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Ice scoop stored outside the ice machine on a non clean surface.--Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Fan covers in the walk-in dirty and require cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Vent hood and filters require more frequent cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors, walls, ceiling dirty and or smoke stained.
